# API response times (generated by scripts/perf/api_timings.py)

Machine: GitHub Actions runner (4 vCPU, 15 GB RAM), SQL Server 2022 Developer and the API in Docker.

| Endpoint | Median ms | p95 ms |
|---|---:|---:|
| List, no filter, page 1 (`/api/requests`) | 13.3 | 16.2 |
| List, one status (`/api/requests?status=Waiting`) | 5.6 | 5.9 |
| List, 2 statuses + priority + date (`/api/requests?status=InProgress&status=Waiting&priority=High&createdFrom=2025-06-01`) | 8.9 | 12.0 |
| List, handler (`/api/requests?assignedTo=דוד פרידמן`) | 4.0 | 5.1 |
| List, organization prefix (`/api/requests?organizationName=כרמל`) | 38.1 | 46.2 |
| List, free-text search (`/api/requests?search=היתר`) | 30.8 | 39.0 |
| List, free-text search, rare term (`/api/requests?search=רימון לוגיסטיקה`) | 35.5 | 36.6 |
| List, page 500 sorted by title (`/api/requests?page=500&pageSize=100&sortBy=title&sortDirection=asc`) | 209.3 | 249.0 |
| Summary, no filter (cache) (`/api/requests/summary`) | 1.0 | 1.1 |
| Summary, priority High (`/api/requests/summary?priority=High`) | 8.1 | 8.7 |
| Request details (`/api/requests/50000`) | 1.8 | 1.9 |
| History (`/api/requests/50000/history`) | 2.5 | 2.6 |
| Lookups (`/api/lookups`) | 48.8 | 58.5 |
